title: Japanese Pibil Chicken Ramen
description: A fusion twist on traditional ramen, featuring juicy pibil chicken and a light, savory broth.

ingredients.name: norteno spice blend
ingredients.notes: or a mix of cumin, chili powder, and coriander

instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine light pibil marinade, norteno spice blend, and pibil paste. Blend until smooth.
Place chicken breast in a shallow dish and pour the pibil marinade over it. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat a large pot of water to boiling. Cook ramen noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet or wok, heat vegetable oil over medium-high heat. Remove chicken from marinade and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes per side.
Transfer chicken to a plate and let rest. In the same skillet, add soy sauce and cook for 1 minute, scraping up any browned bits.
Add cooked ramen noodles to the skillet and toss to coat with soy sauce.
Slice cooked chicken into thin strips and add to the noodles. Toss to combine.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped scallions and sesame seeds if desired.
In a small saucepan, heat the pibil marinade over low heat until warm and fragrant. Serve as a dipping sauce.
In a small bowl, mix together chopped scallions and sesame seeds. Serve as a garnish for the finished dish.
